integrity: The supplied analytical proof is distinct from finite numerical diagnostics. Scientific assessments are self-review and independent validation was not performed.
scientific_limitations: Only fixed-width positive boundary defects and fixed scaled parameter. Higher-order terms, bulk defects, and independent novelty certification are not proved. Relevant historical exact Jordan results cover the unweighted subfamily; an older weighted-shift source was only partially accessible.
title: Universal critical \(q\)-numerical boundary layer under finite edge defects
